artworks.title: Charles Baudelaire
artworks.dimensions:
sheet (trimmed to image): 23.1 x 18.1 cm (9 1/8 x 7 1/8 in.)
mount: 34 x 25.4 cm (13 3/8 x 10 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper body and part of the shoulders of a man in a seated or standing pose. His expression is serious, and he is facing forward. His facial features include a long, straight nose, deep-set eyes, and thin, pursed lips. He has short hair, thinning at the crown. The man is wearing a dark, high-collared coat with a large bow tie over a white shirt. There is no visible jewelry or objects. The background is plain and softly blurred, emphasizing the man's face and attire.

artworks.title: Mädchen im Korsett (Girl in a Corset)
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated from the waist up, with their head tilted back, eyes closed. The facial features include a prominent chin and slightly parted lips, with wavy short hair. They wear a corset and a dark, vertically striped garment covering their legs. Holding two fans, the background is textured with dark shading on one side.

artworks.title: Christ on the Cross
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crucifixion scene. It shows soldiers and onlookers, a figure on a cross with a sign above inscribed with the letters "INRI." Several figures are gathered around the base of the cross, with different expressions and gestures. Some hold spears while others seem to be conversing or pointing towards the figure on the cross. The background features linework indicating a landscape with trees and distant hills, creating depth and setting. The style resembles early engravings or woodcuts, characterized by heavy use of lines and detailed textures to convey form and shadow.

artworks.title: La Maison Enchantée (The Haunted House)
artworks.description: The image shows an ornate building with a prominent facade in the center. The scene includes the building, natural surroundings, intricate architectural details, latticed windows, turrets, chimneys, and grazing livestock. A woman is tending to the animals by a gate. The brushstrokes create a textured quality in the foliage and sky. The color palette is sepia-toned, providing a nostalgic and timeless feel, with dark shading contrasting the lighter tones of the building.

artworks.title: Landscape with a Woman at a Well
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with architectural elements and natural scenery. There is a rustic building with a large arched entrance, figures near its base, various structures, trees, pointed rooftops, and a dome-like structure in the distance. The sky is filled with horizontal lines. The etching style features fine lines with cross-hatching for shadows and texture. The palette is monochromatic, using shades of black and white.

artworks.title: Magot de la Chine
artworks.description: The sculpture depicts a seated figure with a large, rounded belly, smiling broadly with eyes closed. The figure is seated cross-legged with both arms resting on the knees, one hand holding an object. The sculpture is monochromatic in shades of gray with textured drapery. It appears substantial and solid, commanding attention.

artworks.title: A Man Gazing across a Still Pond
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene with a person standing near water, a figure with a staff surrounded by grass and rocks, looking towards the landscape. The horizon with hills and sparse foliage is low in the image. The brushstrokes create texture and depth with detailed etching lines. The color palette is monochrome using different shades of ink. Trees and hills recede in the distance, with birds flying in the sky.

artworks.title: Environs de Dieppe
artworks.description: The image displays a coastal scene with rugged cliffs on the left. The horizon is at the top, and the cliffs form a jagged line against the cloudy sky. The style is detailed, capturing the texture of the rocks and clouds. The color palette is monochrome, with varying shades of black and brown. Close to us are rocky terrain and small dark structures near the cliffs. Further away, a ship with a sail is seen in the sea.

artworks.title: La Maison rouge en Pontrieux
artworks.description: The image depicts an etching of a village street with a traditional building at the center. The vantage point is slightly angled, showing a street corner with architectural details etched in fine lines. The sky is visible just above the rooftops. The color scheme is sepia-toned. Two figures are visible on the street, one standing close to a building corner and the other walking away. More buildings line the street in the distance, with the sky above in the background.

artworks.title: Le Boulevard des Italiens
artworks.description: The image depicts a street scene with a high vantage point. The background shows buildings with chimneys and small windows, partially hidden by trees. The brushstrokes are soft and sketch-like, creating movement. The color palette is subdued with shades of brown, beige, and muted blues and greens. In the foreground, a dog walks on cobblestones, while people in period clothing gather. A horse-drawn carriage moves through the scene. In the distance, there are balconies and foliage.

artworks.title: Perversité
artworks.description: The image shows the head and shoulders of a person in a three-quarter view, with their body turned slightly away and their head inclined towards the viewer. The person's facial features are delicately rendered, with prominent eyes, a nose, and a mouth. The hair is styled close to the scalp with fine details suggesting a textured surface. The person is not wearing any visible clothing, leaving the shoulders and back partially exposed. The surrounding area is dark, contrasting against the illuminated form of the figure. The background does not contain any details, maintaining a deep, dark space that highlights the figure's features.

artworks.title: Jacob's Ladder
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures gathered on a staircase. The scene depicts several figures positioned around and above another figure lying down. The use of lines and shading creates depth and shadow, highlighting the central figures. Strong contrasts of light and dark focus the eye on the interactions and expressions within the assembly. The shading and detail suggest expertise in etching technique.

artworks.title: For dalla porta pia (Villa outside the Porta Pia)
artworks.description: The image depicts an elevated view stretching from a rustic building on the left to distant hills on the horizon. The building is detailed with arches and bricks, situated on a hill. Next to it, two figures walk along a path bordered by a wall and foliage. The horizon shows gentle hills with structures and small, unclear figures. The artwork features fine lines, creating texture in the vegetation and architecture. The color scheme is monochromatic, using shades of brown and sepia. The sky is lightly hatched with sparse clouds, contributing to the serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: Jan de Wael
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man from the waist up. He is sideways with his head slightly tilted. He has a prominent nose, broad forehead, full beard, and mustache. His hair is covered by a cap, and he wears a garment with a large ruff around his neck. The background has vertical shading lines for depth.

artworks.title: View of the River Rhine
artworks.artist: Jan van Aken after Herman Saftleven
artworks.description: The image is a detailed depiction of a landscape viewed from an elevated position. The scene shows a valley leading towards distant mountains. The horizon line marks the division between the landscape and the sky with fluffy clouds and birds. On the right, a group of travelers with a donkey walks along a winding path. On the left, a rocky outcrop and sparse foliage add depth. The landscape features towering mountains in the distance. The image is created using intricate hatching and cross-hatching, in varying shades of sepia.

artworks.title: Small Fishing Boats of Berck (Petites Pêcheuses de Berck)
artworks.description: The image displays a scene with figures and ships in a harbor. The perspective is slightly from above eye level. The horizon is not visible, and ships are arranged in the harbor. The etching style uses dense lines and crosshatching for contrast. The color palette consists of shades of black and off-white. Figures are near us, possibly fishermen, with some in shadow. In the background, there are boats with tall sails, indicating a busy maritime setting.

artworks.title: Les Hirondelles (The Swallows)
artworks.description: The image shows a river with birds flying above. The horizon is situated one-third from the top, with distant trees and a hint of a larger landscape beyond. The artwork features detailed brushstrokes and etching technique, especially in the depiction of birds and water texture. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of black, white, and gray. Birds are shown flying above the river, with some creating ripples on the water. Trees along the riverbanks add depth to the scene.

artworks.title: View of a Town with a Bishop's Tomb
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a riverside scene with a grand architectural structure on the left featuring an ornate archway with detailed carvings and statues. In the distance, there are mountains and scattered buildings on a peninsula, with finely etched clouds in the sky. The brushwork is precise and intricate, using thin lines to create texture and detail. The color palette is monochromatic, in shades of black and white. A small town is depicted to the right with several structures clustered together, and a winding river adds dynamism to the scene.

artworks.title: Celui-la, on peut le mettre en liberté! (This one we can set free!  He is no longer dangerous!)
artworks.description: Three men are depicted in the image. The first man lies in a bed, covered up to his neck with a blanket. He wears a loose shirt, a headband, and looks upward. His right arm hangs over the side of the bed near a jug on the floor. Another man stands above him to the left in a uniform with a hat and coat. Beside him to the right, a third man stands dressed in formal attire with a cape and a top hat. The background shows a textured surface with faint outlines of figures. The setting suggests an indoor scene with somber tones in the characters' attire and expressions.

artworks.title: Repos de la France
artworks.description: The image depicts a man seated on a large, ornate armchair with a crown on top. He is viewed from behind, leaning forward with his arms on the armrests. His head is slightly tilted down and he wears a hat, dark jacket, and light trousers. Two cannon barrels are beside the chair, and a rooster is visible. In the background, a woman stands with her hair up and covered in a shawl.

artworks.title: Le Rajeunissement du Constitutionnel
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a surreal scene with an oversized glass container and papers. The drawing depicts a figure adding elements to the container while another figure sits inside reading newspapers.

artworks.title: Lion Devorant un Cheval (Lion Devouring a Horse)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a lion attacking its prey. The lion is shown with intricate detail, emphasizing its wild mane and determined expression. Its claws are embedded into the prey, partly covered by the lion's body. The background is sketched with varying shades of dark and light to provide depth and contrast to the figures in the foreground. The use of shading and line work creates a dramatic portrayal of the natural struggle in the animal kingdom. The drawing captures the primal nature of predators in the wild.

artworks.title: Cheval de charrette sorti des Limons
artworks.description: The image shows a slightly elevated view of a horse-drawn cart parked in front of a building. The focus is on the scene close to us, where the horse, cart, building, and surroundings are depicted with fine and precise brushstrokes, creating textures. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of browns and greys for depth and contrast. Close to us, a barrel rests next to the building's entrance where two figures interact, while in the distance, walls and rooflines form the backdrop.

artworks.title: The Holy Family
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut within platemark): 30.2 x 19.1 cm (11 7/8 x 7 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: In the image, the upper body of a man, woman, and child are visible. The woman is seated with the child on her lap, facing slightly towards the man who is sitting beside her. She has soft and delicate facial features, with long, flowing hair. The child is looking towards the woman and holds a small bird. The man has a bearded face, with curly hair and is holding a plant stem or reed. They are draped in garments that seem to be made of simple, flowing fabric. They are situated on a stone bench or structure, surrounded by blooming plants to the left, and the backdrop is a textured stone wall with visible lines and details. In the distant background, the sky is suggested by a lack of detail beyond some swirling clouds. At the bottom of the image, there is a line of text in Latin.
